diagram_previews.alt: Four regular hexagons in a two-by-two rhombus arrangement, sharing edges, with an empty circle at each of the sixteen vertices.

The four hexagons with numbers in the sixteen circles: 16 and 15 in the two circles shared by three hexagons, 11 to 14 in the four circles shared by two, and 1 to 10 in the rest, with each hexagon's sum 62 written in its centre.
